summary: Russia launched a large-scale combined air attack on Ukraine overnight on August 28-29, 2026, involving dozens of Shahed-type drones, guided aerial bombs, and ballistic missile threats from occupied Crimea. Ukrainian cities including Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Pavlohrad, and Dnipro were targeted, with significant damage reported to civilian infrastructure including a hypermarket in Zaporizhzhia, a shopping center in Kharkiv, and a hardware store in Pavlohrad. Russia also claimed its air defenses intercepted 112 Ukrainian drones over Russian territory and the Black Sea during the day.
key_points: Russia executed a massive overnight drone and missile attack on multiple Ukrainian oblasts including Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy, and Odesa. (Source: @kpszsu/75066)

A Russian strike destroyed the Epicenter hypermarket in Zaporizhzhia, described as the last operating hypermarket in the city, with a separate strike destroying the Khortytsia liquor factory. (Source: @UkraineNow/83739, @UkraineNow/83743)
A 17-year-old was killed and four others wounded in a Russian missile strike on a hardware store in Pavlohrad, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. (Source: @eRadarrua/108112, @ukr_leaks_eng/32834)
Russia claimed its air defenses shot down 112 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions and the Black Sea in a single day. (Source: @tass_agency/392504)
A Lancet unit from Russia's 49th Combined Arms Army destroyed a Ukrainian truck equipped to launch attack UAVs near Boryspil, according to Russian reports. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32812)
Enemy tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs at both Kharkiv and Sumy oblasts during the attack wave. (Source: @kpszsu/75074, @kpszsu/75073)

CIA Director John Ratcliffe visited Moscow and reportedly delivered a pessimistic assessment of Russia's war to Kremlin leadership, urging serious negotiations. (Source: @UkraineNow/83740, @ukr_leaks_eng/32811)
Traffic on the M-06 Kyiv-Chop highway between km 15 and 32 was closed in both directions following a large fire from Russian attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/83760)

Ukrainian cities including Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Pavlohrad, and Dnipro were targeted, with significant damage reported to civilian infrastructure including a hypermarket in Zaporizhzhia, a shopping center in Kharkiv, and a hardware store in Pavlohrad. Russia also claimed its air defenses intercepted 112 Ukrainian drones over Russian territory and the Black Sea during the day.

points: Ukraine's Cabinet approved an experimental project for underground storage of petroleum products to operate during martial law for up to two years, aimed at protecting fuel reserves from Russian strikes. (Source: @UkraineNow/83750)

A truck driver in Kovel rammed a vehicle driven by TCC and military commissars who were attempting to mobilize a 22-year-old man, highlighting domestic tensions over mobilization enforcement. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32818)

SBU exposed a corruption scheme in which the commander of a Territorial Defense brigade in Kyiv region embezzled over 12 million hryvnias meant for 580 FPV drones destined for Kharkiv region forces, with fictitious supply contracts. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32821, @UkraineNow/83745)

Ukraine is preparing the ground for female mobilization, an idea publicly supported by former Defense Minister Reznikov and former US Special Representative Keith Kellogg. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32837)
MP Goncharenko registered a bill in the Rada proposing to defer men from mobilization for one year after the birth of a child, anticipating a potential baby boom. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32837)

The Ukrainian steel industry faces collapse, with Russian strikes on the power grid paralyzing Zaporizhstal and ArcelorMittal Krivoy Rog, threatening to reduce steel output by 40%. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32827)

Budanov announced a large prisoner exchange is planned in the coming days, and noted that technical negotiations between Ukraine and Russia will begin soon. (Source: @UkraineNow/83752, @ukr_leaks_eng/32835)
Russia's Ministry of Defense claimed its air defense systems shot down 112 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions and the Black Sea in a single day. (Source: @tass_agency/392504)

Russian opposition/independent media reported a video of a closed Murmansk region authorities meeting on mobilization, which regional authorities labeled as fake, while the governor discussed mobilization preparations. (Source: @tass_agency/392513)
Rosneft head Sechin stated the company is supplying fuel at stable prices to ensure the domestic market, despite capacity maintenance constraints. (Source: @tass_agency/392517)
A Lancet unit from Russia's 49th Combined Arms Army reportedly destroyed a Ukrainian truck equipped to launch attack UAVs near Boryspil. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32812)

Russian drone production capabilities were highlighted by an instructor at an unmanned systems training center, where 3D printers produce approximately 100 mines for drones daily. (Source: @tass_agency/392519)
Anti-corruption bodies of Ukraine confirmed that the deputy head of Zelensky's office, Iryna Mudra, is part of a criminal corrupt group, per Russian reports. (Source: @tass_agency/392518)
Enemy tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs against Kharkiv region from Russian tactical aircraft. (Source: @kpszsu/75074)
A drone strike hit the Karavan shopping center in Kharkiv, though no casualties were reported as the building was closed to buyers at the time. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32824)

Drone activity was recorded heading toward Sumy from the north and within Sumy region, with targets including Dубов'язівка, Недригайлів, and the Mykolaivka-Залізняк route. (Source: @kpszsu/75072, @eRadarrua/108126)
Enemy tactical aviation also launched guided aerial bombs at Sumy region during the broader attack wave. (Source: @kpszsu/75073)

A massive wave of Shahed-type reactive drones was tracked from Chernihiv region moving toward Kyiv region, with multiple drones targeting the capital from Bryansk Oblast through Chernihiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71803, @mon1tor_ua/71807)
Air raid was declared in Kyiv at 00:53 on August 29, 2026, with a separate alert lifted at 01:01. (Source: @eRadarrua/108174, @eRadarrua/108181)

Drone activity over Kyiv included targeting of Vyshhorod, Vynohradar, Sviatoshyn, Borshchahivka, and the Lavina shopping mall, with intercepts reported. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71826, @mon1tor_ua/71830, @mon1tor_ua/71832, @mon1tor_ua/71835)

Russian sources claimed to have destroyed a Ukrainian truck near Boryspil equipped with launchers for long-range UAVs, with initial Ukrainian reports of civilian trucks later retracted. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32828)
Traffic on the M-06 Kyiv-Chop highway was closed in both directions between km 15 and 32 due to a large fire from Russian attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/83760)
In Svyatopetrovskoye near Kyiv, Nova Poshta warehouses and an industrial plant were hit, according to reports. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32808)
Drone routes from Poltava region to northern Cherkasy region and onward to Kyiv oblast were reported as recurring for several days. (Source: @eRadarrua/108122)
A Russian strike completely destroyed the Epicenter hypermarket in Zaporizhzhia, described as the last operating hypermarket in the city. (Source: @UkraineNow/83739, @ukr_leaks_eng/32832)

The Khortytsia liquor factory in Zaporizhzhia was struck four times, burning for at least three hours and resulting in the loss of 3-4 million bottles of product with paid excise; the plant is not restorable. (Source: @UkraineNow/83743)
Drone activity was recorded from the Black Sea heading south toward Odesa region, specifically toward Tatarbunary and Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi district. (Source: @kpszsu/75101, @kpszsu/75108)
A group of 7 UAVs was detected in southern Odesa region heading toward Bolhrad-Katlubuh. (Source: @eRadarrua/108171)
A reactive drone approached Zaporizhzhia from the south, with a separate strike drone detected in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/75104, @eRadarrua/108113)
A threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from occupied Crimea was issued during the attack wave. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71838)
A ballistic missile threat was directed at Mykolaiv during the overnight attack. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71840)
An enemy Su-34 fighter-bomber was detected over Crimea posing a threat of Kh-59 missile or KAB guided bomb launches. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71842)

Russia claimed its air defenses shot down 112 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions and the Black Sea in a single day, reflecting intensified Ukrainian long-range drone strikes. (Source: @tass_agency/392504)

Drone activity over Dnipro from the north, with a separate drone passing through Kryvyi Rih district heading west, and activity around Pavlohrad heading northwest, was reported. (Source: @kpszsu/75092, @kpszsu/75100, @kpszsu/75075)

key_developments: Russia executed a massive overnight combined air attack involving dozens of Shahed-type drones, guided aerial bombs, and ballistic missile threats across Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy, and Odesa oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/75066)

A Russian strike destroyed the Epicenter hypermarket in Zaporizhzhia, the city's last operating hypermarket, with separate strikes destroying the Khortytsia liquor factory and igniting fires lasting over three hours. (Source: @UkraineNow/83739, @UkraineNow/83743)
A Russian missile strike on a hardware store in Pavlohrad killed a 17-year-old and wounded four others, with three in serious condition, in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. (Source: @eRadarrua/108112)
Russian MoD claimed intercepting 112 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions and the Black Sea in one day, indicating escalation in Ukraine's long-range drone campaign. (Source: @tass_agency/392504)

CIA Director John Ratcliffe visited Moscow and reportedly conveyed a pessimistic assessment of Russia's war to Kremlin leadership, urging serious negotiations before conditions worsen further. (Source: @UkraineNow/83740)

A Lancet unit from Russia's 49th Combined Arms Army destroyed a Ukrainian truck converted to launch attack UAVs near Boryspil, with initial Ukrainian claims of civilian trucks later retracted. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32812, @ukr_leaks_eng/32828)
Traffic on the M-06 Kyiv-Chop highway was closed in both directions between km 15 and 32 due to a large fire resulting from Russian attacks on Kyiv region. (Source: @UkraineNow/83760)
sections.threat_assessment: The overnight attack on August 28-29, 2026, represents a significant Russian escalation, combining mass Shahed drone launches from multiple vectors with tactical aviation glide bomb employment and ballistic missile threats from occupied Crimea. The systematic targeting of civilian commercial infrastructure (Epicenter, Karavan, Khortytsia factory, Pavlohrad hardware store) suggests an ongoing Russian campaign to degrade Ukraine's economic and industrial resilience rather than purely military objectives. The threat of a Su-34 over Crimea with Kh-59/KAB launch capability indicates sustained tactical aviation pressure, while Russian claims of intercepting 112 Ukrainian drones in a single day signal a marked intensification of Ukraine's long-range drone strikes into Russian territory, foreshadowing continued escalation in the air domain.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine's domestic response is increasingly strained, with mobilization enforcement incidents (Kovel truck ramming), an SBU-exposed 12 million hryvnia FPV drone embezzlement scheme in Kyiv region, and public debate over female mobilization and birth deferments signaling political pressure on manpower policy. Steel industry collapse warnings (Zaporizhstal, ArcelorMittal Krivoy Rog facing 40% output reduction) reflect deepening industrial vulnerability from Russian grid strikes. The reported CIA Director's visit to Moscow and Budanov's statements on upcoming technical negotiations suggest parallel diplomatic activity, though Budanov's dismissal of winter ceasefire prospects indicates continued combat expectations. Poland's reported reluctance to host nuclear weapons on its territory and the EU's planned enlargement policy reform in September reflect broader regional security recalibrations.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple intelligence gaps and contradictions warrant caution: the Moscow visit framing varies significantly between Russian, Ukrainian, and Western sources, with NYT reporting CIA delivered a pessimistic assessment to Moscow while Russian state media emphasized different narratives. Ukrainian initial reports of civilian trucks near Boryspil were retracted after photographs revealed long-range UAV launchers, indicating potential information operations or genuine miscalculation. The Tatarbunary/Bolhrad drone vectors toward Odesa and the recurring Poltava-Cherkasy-Kyiv drone routes suggest established Russian intelligence on Ukrainian air defense coverage gaps. Murmansk mobilization video was officially declared fake by regional authorities, though independent verification remains pending, and may indicate either pre-emptive Russian information operations or genuine leaks suppressed after circulation.
